records.title: Government Scholarship in Saudi Public Universities for Non-Saudi Students (external scholarship) - Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

validation.notes: Official Ministry of Education (Saudi Arabia) brand asset on the official government domain moe.gov.sa, injected site-wide as the masthead brand image linking to /en, i.e. it is the ministry's own identity mark - the awarding body for this scholarship - not a partner or sponsor mark. HTTP GET verified 200, image/svg+xml, 51003 bytes, viewBox 0 0 86 44. Downloaded and rendered to confirm identity: it is the ministry's dot-seeds emblem above the Arabic wordmark 'وزارة التعليم'. MEDIUM rather than HIGH for two honest reasons: (1) this is the white knockout variant (CSS class LogoW), so it is low-contrast on a light card - no colour or black variant of the ministry logo is published anywhere on moe.gov.sa; (2) the ministry publishes no logo specific to this scholarship, so the institutional mark stands in for the programme. If the catalogue prefers an invisible-on-white asset, prefer not_found over this one.

validation.notes: Official E-JUST institutional brand asset on the official university domain ejust.edu.eg, used as the site brand lockup in the navbar on the record's own scholarship page and consistently on /about and /media. Downloaded and visually inspected: the E-JUST emblem (red disc inside a black ring with the rising-sun rays) beside the university name in English, Arabic and Japanese. HTTP GET verified 200, image/png, 13823 bytes, 335x100. MEDIUM for two reasons: (1) the asset is only 335x100 - small, though still well above favicon/badge size; (2) E-JUST publishes no logo specific to the TICAD8 scholarship, so the university mark stands in for the programme. The sibling assets were examined and rejected: ejlogo.png (4760x988) is the white knockout variant and renders invisible on a light background; mini.png is a 53x68 footer mark.
